A guide is one task, start to finish. Keep it to the steps a reader follows,
and link to the explanations instead of repeating them.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Create an API key">
    Open **Settings → API keys** and create a key. It is shown once: keep it
    somewhere safe.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Make a request">
    List your notes with the key in the `Authorization` header:

    ```sh
    curl https://api.example.com/notes \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_API_KEY"
    ```
  </Step>
  <Step title="Read the answer">
    The API answers with the notes as JSON. The
    [API reference](/api) lists every field.
  </Step>
</Steps>
